name: aBop
description: Challenge friends to a DRAW off, send a Nudge, hide a timed Surprise, or play Crossfire. A little more fun, right inside your conversations.
intro: Turn an ordinary message into something you can enjoy together. Open aBop from the Messages app drawer, choose an experience, and send it to a person or group. Recipients need aBop installed to join in.
features: DRAW together
Start a timed drawing challenge with a friend or group chat. Up to eight people can draw, with on-device judging and shareable results.
Nudge and Surprise
Send a lightweight reminder or schedule one for the recipient to accept. Hide a message or photo behind a cover until the perfect reveal time.
Keep the conversation playing
Send a Crossfire game through Messages and take turns in the conversation. Creative tools and optional Apple Intelligence features add a personal touch on supported devices.

name: Chomp Champ
description: Catch the matching food. Dodge the rest. Try to keep a straight face in an AR game that turns every chomp into a challenge.
intro: Open your mouth to catch flying food, move your head to dodge, and see how long you can keep your streak alive. Chomp Champ brings a little augmented-reality absurdity to solo sessions and time with friends.
features: High Streak
Keep catching the right food and climb the Game Center Highest Streak leaderboard.
Easy Mode
Every three-hit streak takes you up a level. A relaxed way to learn the art of the chomp.
Battle Mode
Challenge up to three friends in a real-time food battle. Catch, dodge, and outlast your opponents.

name: Fake Caller
tagline: A call from the good old days.
description: The classic fake incoming call screen returns. Set the caller, pick a ringtone, and bring a little early-iPhone nostalgia to your day.
intro: A playful throwback to the original iPhone incoming call screen, rebuilt for modern iPhones. Customize the setup, preview your fake call, and enjoy a little piece of App Store history. These are simulated calls, not real phone calls.
features: Make it your own
Choose a caller name, photo, wallpaper, and sound.
Time the moment
Schedule your fake call with a timer or a custom time, and check your setup with a live preview.
More ways to play
Try fake FaceTime with custom incoming and callback videos, or import your own audio.

name: Pinky Pile
tagline: A little balance. A lot of wobble.
description: Drop a Pinky. Find the balance. Build a delightfully wobbly tower and see how long you can keep the whole thing standing.
intro: Simple one-tap controls meet unpredictable physics. Drop Pinkys onto the platform, recover from near disasters, and chase your best pile. Easy to pick up, surprisingly hard to put down.
features: One tap, one more Pinky
Time each drop to keep your growing stack balanced.
Playful physics
Every wobble changes the challenge. Adjust your timing as the pile grows.
Beat your best
Short sessions make it easy to squeeze in another attempt at your personal record.

name: Tile Glider
tagline: Find your way into the flow.
description: Flick discs, connect paths, and discover the perfect solution. Handcrafted puzzles for your next small moment of focus.
intro: Plan your route and make every move count. Glide discs across handcrafted boards, earn stars for efficient solutions, and return for a fresh Daily Challenge.
features: Make the perfect move
Solve boards in as few moves as possible to earn stars.
A daily reason to return
Take on a fresh Daily Challenge and compare results through Game Center.
Keep your momentum
Simple swipe controls and helpful hints keep you moving through the puzzles.

name: Word Blitzen
description: One shared board. Sixty seconds. Race to complete words before your opponent, or sharpen your instincts against the trainer.
intro: Spot the word, claim the letters, and beat the clock. Word Blitzen turns a circular letter board into a fast head-to-head challenge, with no waiting for your opponent to take a turn.
features: Real-time word races
Compete in 60-second online matches through Game Center.
Practice your pace
Train against three difficulty levels before taking on other players.
Follow your progress
Track completion times and compare your results on the leaderboards.

name: Block Blitzen
description: Match colors and shapes, set up a clever combo, and beat your opponent to the next move. Small rounds with serious strategy.
intro: Place tiles on a shared grid while your opponent does the same. Match colors or shapes, look for bonus combinations, and balance a clever plan with quick reactions.
features: No waiting your turn
Play head-to-head in real time through Game Center.
Build a bigger combo
Combine color and shape patterns to earn bonus points.
Find your challenge
Practice against three AI difficulty levels and track your scores on the leaderboards.
